Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The umpires and players make their way out in the middle. Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma will be the openers for India Women. Darcie Brown to start the proceedings with the ball for Australia Women.
... THE CHASE …

Right then, India Women have a below-par target in front to overhaul and Harmanpreet Kaur will be confident enough of chasing this down. Will India Women chase it down and take a 2-1 lead in the series? We will find out shortly.

India Women were brilliant with the new ball dismissing Alyssa Healy and Tahlia McGrath cheaply. However, they leaked a lot of runs after the Powerplay and were put under the pump by Beth Mooney, Ellyse Perry and Grace Harris. They clawed their way back into the game during the death overs and as a result, restricted Australia Women to a lower total. Renuka Singh was the pick of the bowlers for India Women with figures of 2 for 24 from her four overs while Anjali Sarvani, Devika Vaidya and Deepti Sharma too chipped in with two wickets each.

A decent end to the innings but Australia Women will feel that they are at least 15 runs short. Sent into bat first, Australia Women were off to a poor start losing two wickets inside the first two overs. Beth Mooney and Ellyse Perry resurrected the innings with a 64-run stand. After the departure of Beth Mooney, Ellyse Perry unleashed herself and put on a show. Grace Harris provided her support and did not shy away from playing her shots. The departure of Ellyse Perry and Grace Harris saw Australia Women lose their way towards the back end of the innings to end up with a below-par total.
FOUR! A boundary to end the innings! Deepti Sharma bowls this short and outside off, Alana King slices it uppishly but through point for a boundary. Australia Women finish on 172 for 8!
Quicker, full and outside off, Alana King slashes at it, but misses. It is a close call for wide, and Deepti Sharma gets away with it.
Floated, full and on off, Megan Schutt drags her sweep towards long on for a single.

Stumping chance...missed! This is short again and outside off, Megan Schutt comes down the track and swings, but misses. Richa Ghosh behind the stumps fails to collect it the first time. However, she picks up the ball and breaks the stumps as Megan Schutt tries to get back in. The umpire sends it upstairs and the replays shows that the bat is grounded and Megan Schutt is safe.
Short and around off, Megan Schutt moves across and mistimes her slog back towards the bowler.
Megan Schutt walks out to bat.

OUT! TAKEN! Another one bites the dust! Australia Women are tumbling here! Deepti Sharma gets her second wicket. She bowls this flatter, short and on midldle, Nicola Carey goes for the reverse-sweep, but get a top edge as the ball loops up towards short third man where Renuka Singh takes a dolly. Australia Women eight down now!
Commentary.Howout: c Renuka Singh b Deepti Sharma

Commentary.Commentary: Deepti Sharma will bowl the final over.
A single to end the over as this full delivery is driven towards long off.
Full and on off, Alana King drives it towards sweeper cover for a single.
A slower one, dipping, on off, Alana King goes for the heave, but misses.
This is almost on a yorker length and outside off, Alana King is late to put her bat down and misses it.
Short and outside off, Alana King cuts it towards deep point for a brace.
Alana King is the new batter in.

OUT! TAKEN! Renuka Singh strikes straightaway! Grace Harris goes back to the hut now. Renuka Singh serves this full and outside off, Grace Harris reaches for it and tries to loft it away, but she loses her grip and the ball goes up in the air of the outer half of the bat. Deepti Sharma at long off runs to her left to take a brilliant catch. Grace Harris was looking dangerous, and this could make a difference in the total.
Commentary.Howout: c Deepti Sharma b Renuka Singh

Commentary.Commentary: Renuka Singh comes on to bowl.
A single to end the over as this full delivery is drilled to long off.
FOUR! HAMMERED! This is short and outside off, Grace Harris moves back and hammers it away wide of long on for a boundary.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Nicola Carey uses here feet and clips it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Streaky but Australia Women will take it! This is quicker, full and on middle, Nicola Carey goes for the reverse-sweep, but gets an inside edge towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Short and outside off, Nicola Carey cuts it towards point.
Nicola Carey walks out to bat.

OUT! TAKEN! Annabel Sutherland tries to go big, but holes out now! Deepti Sharma bowls this short and on leg, angling in, Annabel Sutherland comes down the track and heaves across the line, but mistimes it high in the air towards long on where Radha Yadav setltles under it to take a good catch. Australia Women lose their sixth.
Commentary.Howout: c Radha Yadav b Deepti Sharma

Commentary.Commentary: Deepti Sharma comes back into the attack.
FOUR! Another one for Harris! This full and outside off, Grace Harris drags it from there and slaps it towards the wide long on fence for a boundary.
Short and outside off, Grace Harris cuts it towards point.
FOUR! Good shot! This is full and around leg, Grace Harris goes down and sweeps it towards the deep square leg fence for a boundary.
Length again and on off, Annabel Sutherland check-drives it towards long on for a single.
Short of a length on off, Annabel Sutherland knocks it back to the bowler.
Annabel Sutherland comes out to bat.

OUT! TAKEN! Ellyse Perry is gone! Anjali Sarvani provides the breakthrough! She follows the batter and serves this full and outside off, Ellyse Perry initally thinks about the scoop, but changes her mind and tries to ramp it, but the ball takes the back of her bat and loops up towards short third man. Radha Yadav there fumbles but takes the catch on her second attempt. Ellyse Perry goes after playing a brilliant knock.
Commentary.Howout: c Radha Yadav b Anjali Sarvani

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Grace Harris goes big again! Rajeshwari Gayakwad flights this on up and on off, Grace Harris again skips down the track and dispathches it over the long off fence for a biggie.
Gives this one some air, on off, Grace Harris goes down and sweeps it straight to mid-wicket.
SIX! BANG! Grace Harris looks in good touch here! This is floated, full and on off, Grace Harris dances down the track and smokes it over the long off fence for a biggie.
Flighted and around off, Ellyse Perry uses her feet and yorks herself, but digs it out towards long off for a single.
Flatter, full and outside off, Ellyse Perry slashes it towards point.
FOUR! Nice placement! This is tossed up, full and around off, Ellyse Perry moves across and goes down to nail her sweep towards the deep square leg fence for a boundary.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad is back on.
Fullish outside off, Grace Harris looks to carve this one fine on the off side but misses. A loud appeal for caught behind but the umpire shakes her head.

SIX! Just over! On a length and outside off from over the wicket, Grace Harris frees her arms and swings this one towards long on. Shafali Verma is not standing on the boundary ropes and the ball sails over her head for a maximum.
Fullish on off, Ellyse Perry slices this one to the left of short third man. Radha Yadav slides to her left and keeps it to one.
Back of a length on off, Ellyse Perry cuts this one towards backward point for a dot.
FOUR! On a length and just outside off, Ellyse Perry opens the bat face to use the pace of the delivery and guides this one past short third man for a boundary.
Touch fuller on off, Grace Harris drills this one down the ground towards long on for a single.
Anjali Sarvani (2-0-13-1) is back on.
Short and outside off by Radha Yadav, Grace Harris backs away and cuts this one towards deep cover for a single.
Short and outside off, Ellyse Perry shuffles across and pulls this one to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Floated, touch fuller outside off, Grace Harris slog sweeps this one uppishly towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Low full toss on middle, Ellyse Perry sweeps this one towards deep square leg for a single.
SIX! STRAIGHT HIT! Tossed up, on a length on off, Ellyse Perry makes room by going down the track and swings this one over long on to collect a maximum.
FOUR! Short and quicker on middle, Ellyse Perry moves to the leg side and opens the bat face to guide this one past short third man for a boundary.
FOUR! Floated, full and outside off, Grace Harris gets down on one knee and slog sweeps this one hard and wide of deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Slower and short on off, Ellyse Perry cuts this one straight to cover. Smriti Mandhana there has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses that allows the batters to take a single on the overthrow.
Flatter and shorter outside off, Grace Harris cuts this one firmly towards deep cover for a single.
Tossed up, full and on off, Ellyse Perry gets into the position early and slog sweeps this one towards deep square leg for a single.
Short and quicker at the pads, Ellyse Perry looks to clip this one but misses and gets hit high on the pads.
Flighted, full outside off by Devika Vaidya, Grace Harris swats this one down to long on for a single.
Fuller outside off, Ellyse Perry gets down on one knee and slog sweeps this one wide of deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Short and outside off, Ellyse Perry goes on the back foot and cuts but fails to pierce the gap on the off side.
Radha Yadav fires this one full and down the leg side, Ellyse Perry goes for the sweep but misses. The ball comes off her pads on its way to the keeper.
Short and outside off, Grace Harris cuts this one of the back foot towards deep cover for a single.
Short on off by Radha Yadav, Ellyse Perry pulls this one off the back foot towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Radha Yadav starts with a short delivery on off, Ellyse Perry rocks back and cuts it straight to cover for a dot.
Grace Harris walks out to bat now. Also, Radha Yadav comes into the attack now.

OUT! STUMPED! Tossed up on a length on off by Devika Vaidya, Ashleigh Gardner uses her feet to get to the pitch of the ball and gets deceived by the turn. The ball sneaks past her outside edge and Richa Ghosh whips the bails off in a flash to catch Ashleigh Gardner short of the crease. Australia Women are now 4 down.
Commentary.Howout: st Richa Ghosh b Devika Vaidya

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, full and on off, Ellyse Perry uses her feet and eases it towards long off for a single.
SIX! Cracking shot by Ellyse Perry! Flighted, on a length on middle, Ellyse Perry backs away to free her arms and swings this one towards long on. Clears the fence with ease and collects a maximum.
Tossed up, full on off, Ashleigh Gardner makes room and lofts this one high in the air towards long off for a single.
Short and on middle by Devika Vaidya, Ellyse Perry goes back and pulls this one towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Devika Vaidya bowls a low full toss on leg, Ashleigh Gardner advances down the track and pushes it to long off for a single.
Fullish delivery outside off, Ashleigh Gardner drives this one towards deep cover for a single.
Slower and on a length outside off, Ellyse Perry works this one towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! On a length and outside off, Ellyse Perry frees her arms and lofts this one over the mid off fielder for a boundary. Ellyse Perry is looking in great touch today.
Fuller on leg, Ashleigh Gardner pushes this one towards Rajeshwari Gayakwad at mid on and rushes for a quick single. Ashleigh Gardner was gone had Rajeshwari Gayakwad hit at the non-striker's end.
Good-length delivery outside off, Ashleigh Gardner goes for a drive but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Fullish delivery at the pads, Ashleigh Gardner clips it straight to mid-wicket for a dot.
Renuka Singh (2-0-13-1) is back on.
Floated, full and on off, Ashleigh Gardner gets to the pitch of the ball and drives back past the bowler towards long on for a single.
Flighted, touch fuller at the pads, Ashleigh Gardner uses her feet and works this one past short fine leg. Gets off the mark with a couple of runs.
Tossed up, on a length on leg, Ashleigh Gardner looks to clip this one but misses.
Ashleigh Gardner comes out to the middle now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Devika Vaidya strikes in her first over! Tossed up, full on off by Devika Vaidya, Beth Mooney shimmies down the track to go through covers. Ends up hitting it straight to Shafali Verma at extra cover who makes no mistake. A timely wicket for India Women.
Commentary.Howout: c Shafali Verma b Devika Vaidya

Commentary.Commentary: Floated, full on middle, Ellyse Perry uses her feet and drives this one down to long off for a single.
Devika Vaidya starts with a fuller delivery on leg, Ellyse Perry uses her feet and pushes it to mid-wicket for a dot.
Devika Vaidya comes into the attack now.
Deepti Sharma misses her length and bowls a full toss on middle, Ellyse Perry sweeps this one towards deep square leg for a single.

SIX! SHOT! Tossed up, full and at the pads by Deepti Sharma, Ellyse Perry gets to the pitch of the ball and whips this one towards deep mid-wicket. Clears the fence and collects a maximum. First maximum of the Australia Women innings.
Fullish on off, Beth Mooney dabs this one towards point for a single.
Flighted on middle, Ellyse Perry uses her feet to go down the ground but gets an inside edge back onto her pads. The ball rolls on the leg side for a single.
Deepti Sharma bowls a full toss on off, Beth Mooney pulls this one towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Floated, full on off by Deepti Sharma, Beth Mooney advances down the track and drives past extra cover. Hits it wide of long off for a boundary.
Fuller on off, Beth Mooney gets forward and clips this one towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Slower and on a length on middle, Beth Mooney gets into the position early and sweeps this one behind square on the leg side for the second boundary of the over.
FOUR! Smart batting by Beth Mooney! Tossed up, full on off, Beth Mooney uses her feet and lofts this one over mid off for a boundary.
Short on middle, Ellyse Perry goes back and pushes this one to deep square leg for a single.
Full on off, Beth Mooney uses her feet and drives this one down to long on for a single.
Tossed up on off, Beth Mooney shuffles across to work it on the off side and gets rapped on the pads. A loud appeal but the umpire shakes her head..

FOUR! Consecutive boundaries for Ellyse Perry! Deepti Sharma bowls a full toss at the pads, Ellyse Perry uses her feet and whips this one past mid-wicket to collect a boundary. At the end of the Powerplay, Australia Women are 43 for 2.
FOUR! Floated on middle, Ellyse Perry makes room and goes inside out over covers. Clears the infield with ease and collects a boundary.
Good stop! Fullish outside off, Beth Mooney drives it hard through covers but Rajeshwari Gayakwad at cover dives to her right and keeps it to one.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Ellyse Perry gets to the pitch of the ball and works it to long on for a single.
Full on middle, Ellyse Perry advances and pushes it to extra cover for a dot.
Deepti Sharma starts with a flighted delivery on off, Beth Mooney uses her feet and drives it to mid off for a single.
Shortish and on off, turning away, Ellyse Perry moves back and forces it towards covers.
FOUR! Easy pickings for Perry! This is short and well outside off, Ellyse Perry stays there and cuts it towards the deep point fence for a boundary.
Flatter delivery, on middle, angling in, Ellyse Perry gets cramped and hits it with the inner half onto her pads.
Shorter and outside off, Beth Mooney punches it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Darts this one full and down the leg, Beth Mooney misses her sweep as the ball is grabbed by the keeper. Richa Ghosh appeals for the catch, but the umpire shakes her head. It is called a wide.
Flighted delivery and around off, Beth Mooney uses her feet, but only manages to defend it back towards the bowler.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad starts with a short delivery, on middle, angling in, Beth Mooney tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad is introduced into the attack.
Beth Mooney comes down the track again and knocks this full delivery towards mid off for one more.
Anjali Sarvani pulls her length back a bit, on off, Ellyse Perry pushes it towards mid off for one.
Another full delivery, on off, Beth Mooney uses her feet to cut the swing and drives it through covers for a run.
Full and outside off, Ellyse Perry moves across a bit and drills it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Anjali Sarvani loses here line and serves this full and outside off, way outside off, Ellyse Perry leaves it alone. Wided.
Back of a length and outside off, Ellyse Perry offers no shot at it.
FOUR! Nice shot! This is short and outside off, Ellyse Perry accepts the width and frees her arms to cut it well towards the deep point fence for a boundary.
A slower one now, full and outside off, Ellyse Perry uses her feet and goes for the drive, but gets an inside edge onto her pads as the ball travels towards square leg. They cross.
Full again and on off, Beth Mooney drives it through covers for a run.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Renuka Singh serves this full and outside off, Beth Mooney skips down the track and goes inside out to smash it over extra covers for a boundary.
Pitched up again, on off, Ellyse Perry drills it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Fuller one and on off, Ellyse Perry drives it straight to short covers.
This is on a good length and on middle, Beth Mooney works it towards mid on for a single.
FOUR! Ellyse Perry gets off the mark in style! This is full and outside off, Ellyse Perry goes down and drives it through covers for a beautiful boundary.
Full and on the pads, Ellyse Perry tucks it on the leg side.
On a length and on leg, Ellyse Perry knocks it towards mid-wicket.
Ellyse Perry is the new batter in.

OUT! TIMBER! Anjali Sarvani strikes now! India Women for the first time in this series gets rid of Tahlia McGrath. She has to go back for a low score too. India Women are on top here! Anjali Sarvani bowls this on a hard length and on middle and off, shaping in sharply, Tahlia McGrath looks to drive it, but plays down the wrong line and the ball goes through to shatter the stumps. Australia Women two down now!
Oh..that is close! This is on a good length again and outside off, Tahlia McGrath goes for the cut again, but gets an inside edge onto her pads. It could have easily gone onto the stumps.
Anjali Sarvani begins with a good-length delivery around off, shaping in, Tahlia McGrath tries to cut it away, but misses.
It will be Anjali Sarvani to bowl from the other end.
Goes a bit fuller and on the pads, Beth Mooney nudges it towards fine leg for a couple of runs.
On a length and outside off, Tahlia McGrath pushes it through cover-point for a single and gets off the mark.
Tahlia McGrath walks in at number 3 for Australia Women.

OUT! LBW! Renuka Singh draws first blood! India Women gets the breakthrough in the very first over. Renuka Singh bowls this on a good length and around off, shaping in sharply, Alyssa Healy prods forward to defend, but misses and gets rapped around the pads. There is a huge shout for LBW, and up goes the finger. Alyssa Healy is not happy with the decision, but she has to go back for a low score. Australia Women lose their first.

Risky run! Renuka Singh pitches this one up, on middle, Beth Mooney chips it towards mid on and sets off for the run. Anjali Sarvani picks it up on the bounce and has a shy at the bowler's end, but misses and the run is completed.
This is on a good length and on off, Beth Mooney blocks it down the pitch.
Renuka Singh starts with a full delivery, on off, Alyssa Healy drives it firmly towards mid off for a single. Australia Women are underway straightaway!

We are all set for the action to start. The umpires and players make their way out in the middle. Alyssa Healy and Beth Mooney will be the openers for Australia Women. Renuka Singh to start the proceedings with the ball for India Women.

Pitch Report - Kirby Short is near the deck. She says that there is an even covering of grass. Adds that since it is red soil, there will be good bounce and carry. Feels that this game will be a high-scoring one and the team batting first will need to score around 200. Ends by saying that there will be assistance with the new ball.

Alyssa Healy, the skipper of Australia Women, says that they would have bowled first as well. Adds that they will now look to put runs on the board and defend later. Feels that these are good batting conditions and even though they haven't played at this stadium since 2018, the conditions will be the same. Informs that there are 3 changes to the team that played the last game.

Harmanpreet Kaur, the skipper of India Women, says that since it is a night game, they want to chase. Adds that there will be help for the seamers considering the grass cover and they have bowlers who can swing the ball. Feels that bowlers will go for runs in the T20 format when not bowled according to the plan. Ends by saying that their bowlers have taken responsibility and batters too have done well in the series. Informs that they have made one change to the team that played the last game.

Australia Women (Playing XI) - Alyssa Healy (C/WK), Beth Mooney, Tahlia McGrath, Ashleigh Gardner, Ellyse Perry, Grace Harris (In for Phoebe Litchfield), Annabel Sutherland, Nicola Carey (In for Kim Garth), Alana King, Megan Schutt, Darcie Brown (In for Heather Graham).

India Women (Playing XI) - Smriti Mandhana, Shafali Verma, Jemimah Rodrigues, Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Richa Ghosh (WK), Deepti Sharma, Devika Vaidya, Radha Yadav, Anjali Sarvani, Rajeshwari Gayakwad (In for Meghna Singh), Renuka Singh.
TOSS – The coin toss lands in the favour of India Women and they have opted to bowl first.

On the other hand, Australia Women suffered their first T20I loss of 2022 after facing a defeat in the second T20I of the series. For the visitors, their batters have stepped up and put up good scores in the two T20Is. The bowlers have done a decent job in both T20Is, but they have leaked a lot of runs towards the back end of the innings in both games. Who will win the third T20I and take a 2-1 lead in the five-match T20I series? Toss and team news coming up shortly...

After losing the first T20I, India Women bounced back with a win in the second T20I after the game went down to the Super Over. After a dismal outing with the ball in the first T20I, bowlers did a relatively good job to restrict Australia Women under the score of 200. While the batters have been consistent in the two T20Is, they will need to continue the good work in the remaining three T20Is.

Hello and welcome to our coverage of the third T20I in the five-match T20I series between India Women and Australia Women. With the series nicely poised at 1-1, the action now shifts to Brabourne Stadium in Mumbai for the remaining three T20Is of the series.
... MATCH DAY …

It is now time for the third T20I match betweem India Women and Australia Women. The hosts put up a stellar performance in the second T20I to level the series. India Women do have the momentum on their side and would be aiming to make the most out of it. Smriti Mandhana seems to be in a solid form and can certainly trouble the new ball bowlers of Australia if she sticks around. She holds the key for India after an impressive knock in the previous match. The India bowlers though certainly need to pull their socks up and find a way to penetrate the Aussies batting line-up. Australia Women, on the other hand, would be aiming to get back to winning ways. Australia posted 187 with a loss of just a single wicket in the previous game, this tell you enough what threat they possess with the blade. Although, they could not put up a solid performance with the ball and allowed India to level the scores. Later, the game was decided through Super Over which made the game an entertaining affair. It won't be any different this time around, as both the teams will be fighting to take a lead in this series now. Who will it be? We shall find out together.
